name: CNRS/IGBMC Strasbourg: crystallisation storage and imaging system from Formulatrix Europe (EU tender award; 2023)
brief: A structural biology institute procures, installs and commissions a temperature-controlled storage and automatic imaging system for macromolecular crystallisation plates, with training.

cost.original: EUR 422,208 (TED contract award notice 736894-2023, signed 14.11.2023); USD at about 1.09 USD/EUR (approximate)
cost.excludes_note: Optional preventive-maintenance tranche was not exercised at award. Model not named in the notice.

notes: Out-of-sample round 2: collected blind after the model was frozen at commit 973d0f5. includes corrected from ['instruments', 'integration_labour'] to ['analytics', 'instruments', 'integration_labour'] after scoring, by the rule that a purchase of named equipment covers those items' cost categories (the round-2 collection prompt omitted the category convention). Out-of-sample (oos2 set), found after the cost model was frozen; not used for catalog prices. price_basis=configured (supply, delivery, installation, commissioning, training). Quote (FR): "Fourniture, livraison, installation, mise en service et formation a l'utilisation d'un systeme de stockage et de prise d'images d'experiences de cristallisation des macromolecules biologiques"; winner FORMULATRIX EUROPE, 422208.00. Verified 3 Oct 2026 via TED API/XML. Model unstated (Rock Imager family inferred from vendor and 20 C spec) so proxy to Rock Imager 1000; EUR-USD rate approximate.

equipment.rationale: Closest catalog model to the item named in the source.
